name: adv-02-duplicate-evidence-epoch
invariant: 2 (determinism / no unordered replay); append-only evidence epochs
guard: post_evidence_epoch guard: epoch_index MUST equal previous_epoch_index + 1.
why_rejected: A second epoch re-uses an already-anchored epoch_index (replay) instead of extending the chain by exactly one. Anchoring it would duplicate or overwrite a committed epoch and let the same evidence be counted twice.
